about: internal/opcount: the repository's one instruction counter (a count is whole or refused; a run that did not finish has no number), the workload file of scripts/opcount, and the numbers of a bench.v1 receipt. The counter's real-process tests skip on a host with no hardware counter; the exit hook is checked by hand (an opcount run reports its counters, or NoMetric).

mutants.name: count-no-inherit
mutants.rule: The counter is inherited by the program and every process it starts: the whole tree is counted.

mutants.name: count-not-enabled-at-exec
mutants.rule: The counter starts at the program's exec, so the caller's threads are never counted and the program always is.

mutants.name: count-exit-ignored
mutants.rule: A run that exits with a status other than 0 is RunIncomplete: a failed run is not a fast run.

mutants.name: count-group-left-admitted
mutants.rule: A process of the program's group still running when it exits makes the run RunIncomplete (its count is not in yet).

mutants.name: count-multiplexed-admitted
mutants.rule: A counter that ran for less time than it was enabled is Multiplexed: its short value is never a count.

mutants.name: workload-sizes-unordered
mutants.rule: The small size is below the large one, or the slope divides by zero or flips its sign.

mutants.name: workload-unknown-key-admitted
mutants.rule: A key the workload does not know is a problem at its line, not a silently ignored setting.

mutants.name: workload-duplicate-admitted
mutants.to: if first, dup := seen[key]; dup && false {
mutants.rule: A key given twice is a problem at the second line; the later line does not silently win.

mutants.name: workload-unsized-admitted
mutants.rule: A workload whose arguments and input never name {n} runs the same work at both sizes: a problem at its args line.

mutants.name: workload-required-unchecked
mutants.rule: unit, sizes and args are required.

mutants.name: slope-not-difference
mutants.rule: The cost of a unit is the slope between the two sizes, so a run's fixed cost cancels.

mutants.name: series-refused-value
mutants.rule: A refused series holds no number, whatever the rounds measured.

mutants.name: compare-refused-ratio
mutants.rule: A comparison with a refused side is refused and holds no ratio.

mutants.name: hook-allocs-unreported
mutants.rule: The exit hook reports every counter scripts/opcount reads; a missing one is NoMetric in the receipt, never 0.
mutants.gap: The hook runs only inside a program scripts/opcount builds and runs; its run is a tool check by hand (round-1 request: opcount on examples/lru and examples/onebrc), not a gate test.
